notes.title: Fretless - The Wrath of Riffson, release note for patch 3, build 19804628
notes.content:
[b]Fixed issues, new content[/b]:
[list]
[*] Fixed the passive of the RCA-TT-ACK monster
[*] Fixed descriptions for 8 String crescendo (from 20 damage per input to 2 damage per input)
[*] More fixes for battle not ending
[*] Fix for the Carbon Copy mod softlock if it tries to copy an empty slot
[*] Fix for fighting Oboe-A-Constrictor softlock when using Sapphire Skies Pedal
[*] Various English and French typo fixes
[*] Improved Rebinding on controller
[*] Added PS4 and PS5 controller support (need to disable steam input)
[*] Added Russian!
[/list]

[b]Known issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] KBM rebinding of QTE input still has issues (but can be worked around by closing and reopening the menu)
[*] Double KO with a boss can lead to missing riff visuals (relaunching the game solves it)
[*] The wolves cutscene can fail to end (relaunching the game solves it)
[*] The camera is misplaced when returning to Tonehenge after the bossfight
[/list]

[b]To report new issues:[/b]
If you’re facing any other issues, please report them here:

notes.title: The Fretless OST Vinyl is coming this Summer. Pre-order it now!
notes.content:
The official Fretless Vinyl is coming this Summer and  available for pre-order now!
King Yosef and Ola Englund round off the list of artists already announced alongside Northlane, Andrew Huang, Davie504, Cult of Luna, Rabea Massaad, Yvette Young and Mary Spender.

[url=https://www.g4f-records.com/en/produit/fretless-the-wrath-of-riffson-vinyl-edition/]Players can pre-order the Vinyl directly on G4F records ![/url]


[previewyoutube=8JBAKszv1GI;full][/previewyoutube]



[h2]Meet our latest guests : King Yosef and Ola Englund[/h2]

King Yosef is a producer, vocalist, and multi-instrumentalist from Portland, Oregon, known for fusing the aggression of industrial and metal with the emotional rawness of hip-hop and punk. Emerging from the underground scene, he gained recognition through 
collaborations with artists like Youth Code and his work with the late rapper XXXTentacion, helping define a gritty, genre-defying aesthetic.

In Fretless, King Yosef has composed the theme of the HarperBeast, a musical flying monster waiting for you in the crystal caves.


Ola Englund is a Swedish guitarist, producer, and 
content creator best known for his work in the metal scene and his role as a modern ambassador for heavy music. As the founder of the bands Feared and The Haunted, and the creator behind the gear-focused YouTube channel, he’s become a respected figure both onstage and online. Englund’s playing is rooted in groove-heavy, riff-driven metal, blending melodic sensibility with tight, aggressive rhythms and technical precision.


Find Ola Englund’s music in Fretless during the battle against the Auxarachnid, a bass-powered giant spider lurking in the Dissonant Thicket.

notes.title: The new demo is available now!
notes.content:
Our new demo is available now! 

Explore the first world of Fretless entirely in an updated demo! 
Venture into the new Dissonant Thicket area to encounter its boss, the vibrant Auxarachnid, waiting to catch you on its web. 
Hit the new rhythm-based QTEs in battle to maximize riff efficiency and beat your enemies with sick solos and crescendos! 
Customize your musical adventure with new mods to add to your instruments and new riffs to play on your bass and acoustic guitars!


NEW FEATURES: 

- New boss fight: cross riffs with the Auxarachnid in the Dissonant Thicket
- New QTE system: stay on the beat to out-solo your foes
- New riffs and mods to customize your adventure: add depth to your bass and swing to your acoustic guitar to beat musical monsters and goons
- New tutorialization: learn Fretless' mechanics and riff systems at your own pace, step by step. 

Get ready to rock this weekend! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232724/cbc8726112b200bca0f81ba4df385a43b7bb5511.png[/img]

notes.title: Discover new artworks for the game - and the demo live for a week!
notes.content:
The musical world of Fretless keeps expanding with new artworks by artists David Thor Fjarlason (Dead Cells) and Mari Quinto (Lumi and the Great Big Galaxy) that give us a new glance at the game’s colorful and zany characters. 

To celebrate the occasion, the free game demo (first revealed during Steam’s Save&Sound event) will be available again on Steam for a week from November 20th to November 26th! 

David Thor Fjarlason’s new key art immerses us in the game’s music-inspired environments, where instruments mingle with nature to create new architecture and landscapes - the perfect arenas for turned-based music battles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232724/c8c864bd33ac2acb42cef7b3dbc2d52f10ef84a1.jpg[/img]

Mari Quinto’s vibrant character arts give us a glimpse of Fretless’ colorful personalities:

[list]
[*] Rob, the friendly musician fighting to restore harmony, inspired by Rob Scallon 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232724/0112859bf119c1833ac00ece6cc784ca7b5598e2.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Rick Riffson, Super Metal Records’ boss, trying to own every piece of music with his soul-binding contracts
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232724/abd6b8b0adce67415222b1ce1f85696e19731780.png[/img]

[list]
[*] The fan-favorite percushrooms, who will give you a strong beating, 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232724/cbc8726112b200bca0f81ba4df385a43b7bb5511.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Dr Strum, a disgruntled scientist helping Rob in his quest
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232724/279033153e6b0e766cc8d1cb03cdce87e9904b10.png[/img]

[list]
[*] SMR Larry: the first boss to discover in the game demo, playing sick riffs with his demonic keytar! 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232724/5dd014c243d3db93f296abe4287f007eed93d432.png[/img]

Discover or rediscover Fretless’ musical world in the demo available for a limited time on Steam!

notes.title: Get more Fretless during the weekend: Demo is available until Sunday!
notes.content:
As Save&Sound 2023 came to a close, we decided to get the show going during the weekend with a few surprises: 

- For those who didn't get the chance to shred or pet the dog this week, we've extended demo availability until Sunday. This gives you plenty of time to run in the Bell flowers, fine tune your strategy agains SMR Larry, and maybe find a few power-ups hidden around the map ;) 

- Rob Scallon, the inspiration behind the game and our main character, has tried out the demo for the first time this week and his reaction was priceless. Discover his first impressions and a few anecdotes about the game in a special broadcast on our Steam page, airing all weekend! You might also recognize someone familiar in the video... 

[previewyoutube=B6_RC_hdv8A;full][/previewyoutube]

Fretless' demo is available until Sunday, 8 PM CET / 2 PM ET. After that, you must say goodbye to the Percushrooms for a while. Yes, you do. 

Don't forget to wishlist the game to reunite with them in 2024! 

If you wanna know more about the game, make sure to follow our [url=https://tinyurl.com/475b32p8]newsletter[/url] and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/Playdigious]Twitter/X[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@playdigiousoff]TikTok[/url], and [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCJSfDsPsdHR99IgFZNr5vgA]YouTube[/url].

notes.title: Demo available: discover the world of Fretless during Save&Sound!
notes.content:
As you explore Fretless's melodious world for the first time, you'll be able to discover: 

- A musical turned-based combat system: arrange your favorite riffs and defeat your enemies with powerful crescendos
- Two different instruments to try out: whether you're an acoustic afficionado or a bass-slapping maniac, choose your own playstyle and mod your instruments to amplify your power
- Sick musical-monster hybrids: you already loved the percushrooms. Get ready to meet them for the first time! 
- A first boss encounter: SMR Larry is one of our personal favourites, and we're sure you'll understand why soon.

Come enjoy every musical element or wholesome encounter we sprinkled for your first adventure (and don't forget to give the dog some love!) 

Download the public demo today and wishlist the game to be notified at release next year!
